leads.title: Marriage Act No. 10 of 1974
leads.documents: Limits marriage to opposite-sex couples under statutory and customary law; no same-sex marriage or civil union recognition.

leads.title: Labour Act 2024
leads.documents: Bans discrimination based on sexual orientation in employment; defines gender-based violence and harassment in workplace to include sex, gender or gender identity.

leads.title: Children's Protection and Welfare Act 2011 - Section 127(4)
leads.documents: Prohibits unfair discrimination including on basis of sexual orientation in selection of diversion programme and guarantees equal access.
leads.detail: Cited as 'Section 127(4) of the Children's Protection and Welfare Act 2011'

leads.title: Credit Reporting Regulations (2013)
leads.documents: Prohibits credit bureau records containing information relating to sexual orientation except as self-evident from marital status and family members.
leads.detail: Cited as 'Since 2013, the Credit Reporting Regulations'

leads.title: Child Welfare and Protection Act of 2011
leads.documents: Governs adoptions; only married opposite-sex couples may adopt jointly, single men and same-sex couples not permitted.
leads.detail: Cited as 'The Child Welfare and Protection Act of 2011'

leads.title: National Identity Cards Act 9 of 2011 - Section 8(1)
leads.documents: Requires Director to ensure Register personal information is complete, accurate and updated; cited as possible basis for transgender people to change legal gender on identity documents.
leads.detail: Cited as 'National Identity Cards Act 9 of 2011' Section 8(1)

leads.title: U.S. Department of State Country Reports on Human Rights Practices for 2016 - Lesotho
leads.documents: Documents non-enforcement of law prohibiting consensual sex between men, silence on sex between women, societal discrimination and official insensitivity, taboo, under-reporting, Matrix reports on health care and religious discrimination, Dec 2015 case of lesbian forced from home with police intervention, 21 May IDAHOT march with supportive police escort, billboard in Maseru.
leads.detail: Cited as 'The U.S. Department of State's Country Reports on Human Rights Practices for 2016' - Acts of Violence, Discrimination, and Other Abuses Based on Sexual Orientation and Gender Identity; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Matrix Support Group
leads.documents: LGBTQ NGO established 2009, registered 2010; organized first gay pride march 18 May 2013 in Maseru with authorities escort; annual pride events; outreach to Lesotho Mounted Police Service (LMPS).
leads.detail: Cited as organizer of 18 May 2013 march and source for 2016 State Dept report; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Deputy Prime Minister Mothetjoa Metsing - June media remarks after UN General Assembly High-Level Meeting on HIV/AIDS
leads.documents: First high-level government pronouncement that government would look into decriminalizing same-sex relationships to stop spread of HIV.
leads.detail: Cited as 'Addressing the media in June following the UN General Assembly High-Level Meeting on HIV/AIDS'
